# Corrosion Study

## Overview
This wiki page compiles research regarding capacitive soil probe corrosion, sourced from community forum discussions and technical [documentation](./documentation.md). It evaluates the longevity of different soil probe designs in varying soil conditions, informing [hardware](./hardware.md) selection and total cost of ownership (TCO) calculations.

## Key Details
- **Cheap Probes:** Typically fail within 6 to 9 months when deployed in acidic soil environments.
- **[SenseNode SN-400](./sensenode-sn-400.md):** Features a coated probe designed to resist degradation; replacement probes cost $12.
- **[Aurora Labs](./aurora-labs.md) Beta Probe:** Utilizes a gold-flashed PCB design, though long-term durability remains untested.
